notes.title: January 2024 Update - Hand interaction
notes.notes:
We have updated our interaction toolkit, generating the following effects:

- Hand mesh remains visible while holding objects.
- Hand mesh properly adapts to held object.
- Hand poses as it approaches buttons.
- Updated toy attachment points.
- Adjusted toy and toy pieces colliders.

These updates are meant to improve the experience within the first level. An upcoming update will include a new thematic level, as well as take care of further adjustments to the game content, and its interactivity.

MindFly Studio.
